Remark
[curvature symmetries from the commutator]

Source: petersen:page-0283 ↗ lem:pet-ch6-third-partial-commutator 1. ch6:6.7.6Using $R(\partial c/\partial s,\partial c/\partial t)\partial c/\partial u =\partial ^3c/\partial s\, \partial t\, \partial u -\partial ^3c/\partial t\, \partial s\, \partial u$, show that the two skew-symmetries and the first Bianchi identity for the curvature tensor (proposition 3.1.1 of the source) hold.
